items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: So we told him, well Mr. Honey, see we can go in the bar of Charlie, but my sister can't go in there.

ctx.x: Well anyway, I can't really think, you know. But anyway, we sang for the parent teacher meeting, and everybody enjoyed it. And so the next day when I went to school, you see we were all in the same school, but we were in different classes, you know. So a girl came in and said, Mr. Honey, Mr. Honey was the principal, you know. I said, Mr. Honey want to see Curtis Mitchell, you know. Well I know I had did nothing wrong, you know. I'm wondering what he wants. He wants me in his office. So when I go there, I see my…
Were a lot of your peer groups, people your own age, were they singing quartets, singing in church?
